description: We are opening a single-storey retail shop in Calgary. The building area is 180 m2, there is no basement and no mezzanine. Slab-on-ground floor; lumber roof joists span 4.5 m from the Part 9 span tables (no roof trusses); plain concrete footings from the Section 9.15 tables; no sprinkler or fire alarm system; not on permafrost; the building official has not asked for professional drawings.

gold.engineering_reason: A 1-storey mercantile building of 500 m2 or less is a general exception (Div C 2.4.1.1.(1)(d)(i)); with no basement or mezzanine its gross area is also 180 m2, within Architects Act s.2(6)(d)(i) and EGPA s.2(7)(d)(i). No Part 9 to Part 4 trigger is stated: spans are at most 12.20 m and floor joists at most 4.9 m, live load is residential, Calgary 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure is 0.48 kPa (below 1.2) and Sa(0.2) is 0.192 (not above 1.2 or 1.8), no wood roof trusses, no sprinkler/alarm system, and no AHJ direction under Div C 2.4.1.1.(4).
gold.limit_source: Div A 1.3.3.3.(1) (Part 9 applies); Div C 2.4.1.1.(1) exception; Architects Act s.2(5)-(6) and EGPA s.2(6)-(7) exceptions; Part 4 triggers absent per Div B 9.23.1.1.(1), 9.15.3.3.(1), 9.23.3.5.(4), 9.23.6.1.(6), 9.23.16.5.(3); Div B Appendix C Tables C-2/C-3 (Calgary).

assumptions: Floor is slab-on-ground not carrying superstructure loads (Div B 9.16.1.2.(1) not triggered); no suspended floor, so Div B 9.23.4.1.(2) (non-residential floor spans) does not apply.
No AHJ direction under Div C 2.4.1.1.(4) or Administrative Items Regulation s.18 (stated in the text as "has not asked for professional drawings").
Rafter and joist sizes taken from the Part 9 span tables (Div B 9.23.4.2.); table values not re-checked here.
